title: Avocado with a smiling face

  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="66" rx="3.2" ry="2" fill="#d9755a" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="66" rx="3.2" ry="2" fill="#d9755a" opacity="0.8"/>
